title: 4/28-7/13 deploy race: the deploy step reset the box to mutable origin/deploy, so an in-flight run could install a later queued commit its own gate never tested
tier_reason: latent deploy-integrity defect; run metadata shows no gate-window overlap after the test gate existed and no cancelled runs; fixed 7/13; no residual

contract.text: A deploy installs exactly the commit its own test gate passed (github.sha).
contract.source: .github/workflows/deploy.yml TARGET_SHA comment (30452eb); 1ac0b0c (deploys gated on the test suite)

mechanism.text: the deploy script ran `git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/deploy` when the SSH step executed, reading the mutable ref: a push landing between a run's gate and its reset would be installed by the earlier run (from 7/10 the queue-not-cancel concurrency widened this window)

watchdog.trigger: a deploy run's installed SHA ('Deployed <sha>') differs from its head SHA, or a later push to deploy lands between a run's creation and its reset
watchdog.recovery_assertion: every successful run's deployed SHA equals its head SHA (deploy_runs.json)

evidence.what: deploy resets to the run's tested SHA, not mutable origin/deploy: 'an in-flight run could ship a later queued commit whose own test/environment gate never ran'
review finding (no incident cited); R6 (6d74d39) changed concurrency from cancel-in-progress to queueing

99 runs (93 successful), no cancelled conclusion; after the gate (6/10) the shortest gap from a successful run to the next run is 13.35 min (27435517686 -> 27436209932, 6/12), longer than the created-to-reset interval of every gated retained-log run (2.9-9.6 min, 23 runs); after the queueing change (run 29119047694, 7/10 19:44:57Z) no other run started before the fix run (7/13 01:08:13Z)
each run's deployed SHA equals its head SHA

notes: exposure: reset to origin/deploy since a5af424 (4/28, the fix for the silent no-op deploys, I-037); 'untested' applies only once the gate existed (1ac0b0c, first candidate install 6/10); before the gate a racing run could only change which already-ungated commit was installed
with cancel-in-progress true (4/28-7/10) a completed race would normally leave a cancelled run; none exists
ref 6d74d39: deploy.yml runs from each run's pushed head; run 29119047694 (head 6d74d39, retained log) executed the defective step
fixtures: filled from Task 5/6 acceptance objects at build time
